title: "Mobility Health Observatory"
subtitle: "Synthetic exposure, safety, and health analytics across Great Britain"
---

Welcome to the **Mobility Health Observatory (MHO)**. This platform provides data-driven insights into how human movement, transport systems, and synthetic exposure metrics intersect with public health, road safety, and long-term population trends.

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-6}
### Key Focus: Synthetic Exposure
Unlike traditional transport observatories that rely solely on sparse physical counters, MHO integrates synthetic exposure variables—estimating population-level risk baselines across temporal and geographic boundaries.
:::

::: {.g-col-6}
### Long-Term Dynamics
Using Age-Period-Cohort (APC) models and Lexis framework projections, we isolate structural demographic changes from short-term policy shifts or exposure fluctuations.
:::

:::

## Observatory Modules

| Module | Scope & Methodology | Coverage |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **[Synthetic Exposure](pages/exposure.qmd)** | Synthetic travel patterns, distance metrics, and activity baselines | England & Wales / GB |
| **[APC Models & Lexis](pages/apc-models.qmd)** | Age-Period-Cohort fits, long-term trends, and Lexis diagrams | Great Britain |
| **[Health & Environment](pages/health-impacts.qmd)** | Noise pollution, active travel benefits, and multi-outcome risks | Selected GB Regions |
